title: 第137章 去吧，我的儿子
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林恩想了想，他还真没有什么能解毒的词条。

面甲后面眉毛拧成了一团。

一个毒素，不光能腐蚀身体，还能蹭bUff往上叠，这合理吗？？？

一个个的邪神整天亲自下场害人家的小辈，真不要脸。

治愈光环其实对原体是有用的，但是对混沌剧毒没用。

治愈光环修复好基里曼的身体，混沌剧毒就一直破坏基里曼的身体。

林恩完全被恶心到了。

恐虐好歹还有个光明正大，其他三个完全就是不要脸。

基里曼又被卡班哈砸退了半步。

蓝色光点的亮度短暂地晃了一下，然后又慢慢地回升。

混沌剧毒又发作了一轮。

“……”

以前只觉得色孽是变态，还真的是小看它了，它弄出来的这个混沌剧毒还真的把林恩难住了。

所以它现在是阴沟里的老鼠PlUS版。

别慌别慌思考一下思考一下。

林恩大脑飞速运转。

他没有解毒词条，现抽也来不及了，系统也不可能让他提前透支抽奖次数。

他现在唯一能跟解毒扯上关系的词条就是……

【净化光环】。

清除一个目标身上的混沌腐化。

副作用是可能会被混沌诸神注意到，但因为林恩本人没有亚空间投影，邪神看了也白看。

老十三脖子上的混沌剧毒表面上是剧毒，实际上是色孽的力量附着在剧毒上侵蚀他的躯体。

剧毒不是重点，混沌才是。

净化光环可能不管剧毒，但它管混沌。

混沌剧毒不好清除，但是普通剧毒呢？

把混沌的部分剥离掉，剩下的部分就是一个普通的有害物质。哆啦考尔给摄政王打造的命运之甲本身就是一个移动ICU，搭载着最顶尖的毒素处理系统。

对啊！！！

如果他不能保证把基里曼的毒洗掉，那他就把毒的混沌属性洗掉。把色孽的腐化撕了，剧毒就会变成普通毒！

Page (1/3)

Linn thought for a while, and he really didn't have any words that could detoxify him.

His eyebrows knitted together behind his visor.

A toxin can not only corrode the body, but also rub it upwards. Is this reasonable???

The evil gods are personally harming other people's juniors all day long. It's so shameless.

The healing aura is actually useful against the Primarch, but not against Chaos Poison.

The healing aura repaired Guilliman's body, but the Chaos poison continued to destroy Guilliman's body.

Lynn was completely disgusted.

Khorne is still above all, but the other three are completely shameless.

Guilliman was knocked back half a step by Kabanha again.

The brightness of the blue light flickered briefly, then slowly rose again.

The poison of chaos struck again.

"..."

I used to think that Slaanesh was a pervert, but I really underestimated it. The chaotic poison it created really stumped Linn.

So it's now the Rat in the Gutter Plus version.

Don't panic, don't panic, think about it, think about it.

Lynn's mind was racing.

He had no detoxification entry, and it was too late to draw now, and the system would not allow him to overdraw the number of draws in advance.

The only word he can relate to detoxification is...

【Purifying Aura】.

Removes Chaos Corruption from a target.

The side effect is that it may be noticed by the Chaos Gods, but because Linn himself has no subspace projection, the evil gods will see it in vain.

The Chaos Poison on Old Thirteen's neck appears to be poison, but is actually the power of Slaanesh attached to the poison and corroding his body.

Poison is not the point, chaos is.

The Purifying Aura may not care about poison, but it does deal with chaos.

Chaos poison is difficult to remove, but what about ordinary poison?

Strip away the chaotic part, and the remaining part is just an ordinary harmful substance.The Armor of Destiny built by Doracall for the Regent is itself a mobile ICU, equipped with the most advanced toxin processing system.

yes!!!

If he couldn't guarantee to wash away Guilliman's poison, then he would wash away the chaos attribute of the poison.Tear away the corruption of Slaanesh, and the poison will turn into a normal poison!
